object: containerised electrical module: corrugated steel box on a corner-post frame, with door, louvres and junction boxes
understanding: Corrugated sheet between heavy corner posts and rails. Corrugation makes the walls stiff along the ribs, so hits leave local dents that flatten a few ribs; the posts and rails stay straight.
Hurt by crane loads and vehicles at the lower half, and things landing on the roof, which sags between rails.
Rust streaks down from the roof edge and every fitting, heavy along the bottom rail and in flattened ribs; paint chalks and wears on the rib crests.
